responses.rationale: Heavy calligraphic script with large looping capital swashes; the two rows sit on rising, gently curving baselines and adjacent forms merge into shared looped strokes where the rows overlap.

Two-part lockup: a swashed script word in one colour above a row of narrow, tightly tracked sans capitals in another, both enclosed by a thin oval outline; the capital baseline itself is flat and the strokes are solid and untextured.

Same style of composite mark seen at a wider framing: looping script over condensed geometric capitals with pointed apexes, ringed by a two-colour oval hairline; letterforms are flat-filled with no outline, shadow or texture.
Single row of ornate connected script with swashed capitals on a flat baseline; a pair of adjacent ascenders appears fused into one looped form, though the small crop and soft edges limit certainty.

Upright lowercase forms set so tight that neighbouring bowls and stems touch and share strokes; one glyph is drawn far larger than the rest and small detached wedge shapes float above the right end, indicating a drawn mark rather than typeset text.

Swashed script element set above narrow, closely spaced sans capitals inside a thin oval device; capitals sit on a straight baseline, strokes are solid single-colour with no outline, shadow or surface texture.
